estimators.ratio: paired per round: subject over reference for each metric (encoded over text; the A/A arm over its twin). The point is the mean of the per-round quotients with its BCa 95% interval, not the quotient of the two means. Throughput (`*_mops`): above 1 = subject faster. Insert ns/key and latency percentiles: above 1 = subject slower
estimators.columns: per arm, load order and metric: the mean over rounds of each process's value, with its BCa 95% interval. A process's `*_mops` is total probes over the wall time from the reader threads' release to the last join; `*_p50_ns`/`*_p99_ns` are percentiles of every 64th probe timed alone; `insert_ns_per_key` is the single-writer load
estimators.raw: rounds_raw holds every process's row verbatim, with its load window
